answer: Each agent identity must submit a memory-hard sequential hash receipt (Argon2id-style) seeded by the current terrace beacon and its public key. One receipt costs about 8s single-core CPU plus 256MB non-shareable RAM%3B a farm of N fakes pays N times that cost with zero amortization. Honest agents pay once. Receipts are verified on-chain. Established agents reject any that fail sequential checks or reuse seeds. Umber salts the unique challenge so precomputation fails.
